question: FIH Men's Hockey World Cup 2023 was held in which Indian state/UT?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The FIH Men's Hockey World Cup 2023 was held in the Indian state of **Odisha**.
 
• Odisha hosted the event in the cities of **Bhubaneswar** and **Rourkela**.
 
• This is the second consecutive time that Odisha has hosted the Men's Hockey World Cup, with the previous event held in 2018.
 
• The event saw participation from teams across the globe, competing for the prestigious title.
 
• Hosting the World Cup has significantly boosted Odisha's reputation as a major center for hockey in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Odisha has been investing heavily in sports infrastructure and development, particularly in hockey.
 
• The Kalinga Stadium in Bhubaneswar and the Birsa Munda International Hockey Stadium in Rourkela were the primary venues for the tournament.
 
• The state government's proactive role in promoting sports has led to the successful organization of several national and international events.
 
• Odisha's commitment to sports is evident from its long-term sponsorship of the Indian national hockey teams.
 
• The FIH Men's Hockey World Cup 2023 further cemented India's position as a key destination for international hockey events.
